intermediate.name: Col du Galibier
intermediate.title: KOM Sprint (HC) Col du Galibier (120.7 km)

story: Team UAE set a high pace on the Galibier, after which Tadej Pogacar attacked 1k below the summit. On the top he had 9 seconds on Vingegaard, which grew to 37 seconds in Valloire.
